text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer. Let's seize the
day, shall
we?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, well, you see... Something
wonderful has
happened.
choice_data_list: You're even more motivated than usual.
You're even more motivated than us...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"How are you doing, Ardan? Back
then..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"I said that you'd never be able to run.
I'm really
sorry about that."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"I saw you racing on TV, and you know?
And you
were so, so cool!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
"So I'm going to work harder than ever
so I can
recover and be just as cool as
you!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes... A letter from a girl who was in the
same
hospital as I was, many years ago.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
My running has brought light to
another's heart. I
take great pride in
that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's go. This heart, these
legs...
They've been blessed with an
irreplaceable honor!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With her head held high, Mejiro Ardan
looks even
prouder than usual today.
